record.bible_text: Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> this word<WH01697> that the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> against you, O children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, against the whole family<WH04940> which I brought up<WH05927><WTH8689> from the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Can a bird<WH06833> fall<WH05307><WTH8799> in a snare<WH06341> upon the earth<WH0776>, where no gin<WH04170> <FI>is<Fi> for him? shall <FI>one<Fi> take up<WH05927><WTH8799> a snare<WH06341> from the earth<WH0127>, and have taken<WH03920><WTH8799> nothing at all<WH03920><WTH8800>?

Shall a trumpet<WH07782> be blown<WH08628><WTH8735> in the city<WH05892>, and the people<WH05971> not be afraid<WH02729><WTH8799>? shall there be evil<WH07451> in a city<WH05892>, and the LORD<WH03068> hath not done<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> ? <RF>be afraid: or, run together?<Rf> <RF>the LORD...: or, shall not the LORD do somewhat?<Rf>
Surely the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> will do<WH06213><WTH8799> nothing<WH01697>, but he revealeth<WH01540><WTH8804> his secret<WH05475> unto his servants<WH05650> the prophets<WH05030>.
The lion<WH0738> hath roared<WH07580><WTH8804>, who will not<WH03808> fear<WH03372><WTH8799>? the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>, who can but prophesy<WH05012><WTH8735>?<CM>

Publish<WH08085><WTH8685> in the palaces<WH0759> at Ashdod<WH0795>, and in the palaces<WH0759> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, and say<WH0559><WTH8798>, Assemble<WH0622><WTH8734> yourselves upon the mountains<WH02022> of Samaria<WH08111>, and behold<WH07200><WTH8798> the great<WH07227> tumults<WH04103> in the midst<WH07130> thereof, and the oppressed<WH06217> in the midst<WH08432> thereof. <RF>oppressed: or, oppressions<Rf>

For they know<WH03045><WTH8804> not to do<WH06213><WTH8800> right<WH05229>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, who store<WH0686><WTH8802> up violence<WH02555> and robbery<WH07701> in their palaces<WH0759>. <RF>robbery: or, spoil<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; An adversary<WH06862> <FI>there shall be<Fi> even round about<WH05439> the land<WH0776>; and he shall bring down<WH03381><WTH8689> thy strength<WH05797> from thee, and thy palaces<WH0759> shall be spoiled<WH0962><WTH8738>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; As the shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802> taketh out<WH05337><WTH8686> of the mouth<WH06310> of the lion<WH0738> two<WH08147> legs<WH03767>, or a piece<WH0915> of an ear<WH0241>; so shall the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> be taken out<WH05337><WTH8735> that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> in Samaria<WH08111> in the corner<WH06285> of a bed<WH04296>, and in Damascus<WH01833> <FI>in<Fi> a couch<WH06210>. <RF>taketh: Heb. delivereth<Rf> <RF>in Damascus...: or, on the bed's feet<Rf>
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> ye, and testify<WH05749><WTH8685> in the house<WH01004> of Jacob<WH03290>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, the God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>,

That in the day<WH03117> that I shall visit<WH06485><WTH8800> the transgressions<WH06588> of Israel<WH03478> upon him I will also visit<WH06485><WTH8804> the altars<WH04196> of Bethel<WH01008>: and the horns<WH07161> of the altar<WH04196> shall be cut off<WH01438><WTH8738>, and fall<WH05307><WTH8804> to the ground<WH0776>. <RF>visit: or, punish Israel for<Rf>

And I will smite<WH05221><WTH8689> the winter<WH02779> house<WH01004> with the summer<WH07019> house<WH01004>; and the houses<WH01004> of ivory<WH08127> shall perish<WH06><WTH8804>, and the great<WH07227> houses<WH01004> shall have an end<WH05486><WTH8804>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
